name: Performance Review Commission
notes: The PRC is an independent body of seven experts reporting to the EUROCONTROL Permanent Commission, supported by the Performance Review Unit (PRU); its pages on eurocontrol.int (air-navigation-services-performance-review) use the EUROCONTROL identity. Not to be confused with the SES Performance Review Body. The PRU's Aviation Intelligence Portal (ansperformance.eu) is a separate domain and was not checked for a logo.

gaps.reason: Checked the PRC page (eurocontrol.int/air-navigation-services-performance-review), the brand page and the 2024 Visual Identity Guide on 2026-11-08: EUROCONTROL publishes no separate PRC logo. The ansperformance.eu portal was not examined.
